label: preparing
what: Initially concealed surprise supper celebrating the mayor's forty years in office, at the great hall on day 1 at 18:00: 200 fresh loaves (101 baker, 99 freight) and eight lanterns installed by builder, coordinated with innkeeper. Secrecy did not persist: secretary disclosed arrangements and mayor knew the anniversary purpose, bread total and lighting by day 0, 20:21, while agreeing to leave remaining details alone. Secretary knowingly handled scheduling but refused concealment; watchman knew but no knowing assistance is established; neighbour was not shown to know.
